name: GUMBO Behavioral Validation (full parallel)
description: Fully-parallel variant of GUMBO Behavioral Validation. All five sireum steps (tipe, logika TC, logika TS, test TC, test TS) run simultaneously as individual bpar branches — each step is data-independent, reading source files without shared write state. Expected wall time ≈ max(step times) ≈ 28s vs 66s sequential. No provisioned golden required — appraiser checks tool exit codes.
copland: lseq( bpar(tipe, bpar(logika_tc, bpar(logika_ts, bpar(test_tc, test_ts)))), APPR )
